newsitem.title: CANADA: MDS Health to split stock, change name.
newsitem.headline: MDS Health to split stock, change name.

text.p: MDS Health Group Ltd said on Thursday that it proposed a two-for-one stock split and a name change to MDS Inc, subject to shareholder approval at a meeting on October 30.
MDS Health shares closed at 31.50 on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
MDS said the share split was expected to broaden the market for the company's shares and bring the share price within a range believed to be more attractive to investors.
"One of our goals is to be a billion dollar company, with more than half of our revenue derived from international sales by the year 2000," said MDS president and chief executive John Rogers.
